description: skill-guard: redirect noisy inline skills to subagents. worktree-guard: enforce exit-safety order on git worktree remove. skill-atlas-guard: block a plugin-repo commit that edits a SKILL.md until skill-atlas re-runs (stale fleet-health gate). skill-path-fallback: deny a Bash command with an unexpanded ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and tell the model how to resolve the real script path. learn-capture (Stop) + session-replay (SessionStart): the [LEARN] sedimentation loop — capture markers into .claude/LEARNED.md, replay last 5 at session start. plan-anchor (SessionStart source=compact): replay the live plan's locked constraints (reference source / done-means / out-of-scope) that compaction drops. standby-watchdog (Stop): one nudge when a session parks itself narrating a wait while background work runs — notify the user instead of hanging silently. security-warning-relay (PostToolUse Agent): a subagent's SECURITY WARNING gets surfaced to the user, not read past. compact-audit (PostCompact): record which plan anchors each compaction summary dropped, into ~/.claude/observability/compaction.jsonl — no model call, substring checks only.
